checklist.why: One-line job (the chooser); PickerField named for the trigger
No explicit when-not; Segment, TaskChoice and the filter chips are not named as alternatives
Row parts named (label, meta, 24px trailing slot); search, empty and lead named
multi mode has no preview and no screen; radio rows and inline Choice ship on screens only in the TaskRadios face
States listed, but multi, pressed and empty are not rendered; disabled has a reason pattern (omit)
Rows 58-60px pass; the Clear text action is 44x44
No cap on rows per group or on when search must appear
Check, checkbox and ring plus 600/700 weight, not colour only
No label length or truncation rule; no long-label example
role=radio/radiogroup, roving tab stop, arrows via radioBind, focus ring stated
Raw px throughout and #eaf0e2 press fill; no CSS variable list
Not a text field; search has an aria-label
No related links; classification not stated on the page
375px render has no multi, empty or pressed state

variants.name: navigate
findings: The condition picker draws its own .catalog-category door rows instead of choiceRow navigate; its meta sits under the label while the medicine picker puts it right of the label

variants.name: single
findings: PickerField.pickerOptions draws the same single-select row again (st-picker-option, green check) beside choiceRow single (ink check): two implementations of one row

variants.name: multi
findings: No screen uses choiceRow multi; the only multi chooser (condition picker) hand-rolls .catalog-item with the checkbox on the LEFT, breaking the trailing-slot rule

variants.name: radio rows (candidate; TaskRadios face)
findings: Two faces of one radio row (DS panel rows vs TaskRadios flat rows) with different chosen weight (700 vs 400)

variants.name: inline Choice (candidate)
findings: Clear is 44x44, below the 48px glove floor

findings.text: The multi-select chooser on real screens (condition picker) does not use ChoiceList: it hand-rolls checkbox rows with the box on the left, and door rows with their own meta layout.
findings.fix: Render the condition picker with choiceRow({mode:"multi"}) and choiceRow({mode:"navigate", meta:"10 symptoms · 1 selected"}); delete the .catalog-item and .catalog-category styles.

findings.text: Single-select rows exist twice: choiceRow single (ink check) and pickerOptions (st-picker-option, green check).
findings.fix: Make pickerOptions a thin wrapper that returns choiceGroup(choiceRow single ...) and delete the st-picker-option CSS.

findings.text: multi mode, the empty state and the pressed state are missing from the preview, so the 375px proof does not cover the component.
findings.fix: Add to preview.html a multi group with one checked row, a choiceEmpty line and a row forced into its pressed fill.

findings.text: The Clear text action measures 44x44, below the 48px glove floor.
findings.fix: Set .st-text-action min-height and min-width to control-height (48px).

findings.text: No when-not, no row cap, no label-length rule; raw px and #eaf0e2 instead of tokens.
findings.fix: Add "Use Segment for 2-5 fixed short options in a filter; use TaskChoice for a choice that changes the page"; cap a group at about 8 rows before search; map the press fill to choice-press.

proposals.name: pickerOptions into ChoiceList single
proposals.why: Same job, same row, two implementations with different check colours

proposals.name: Segment: facet (filter choice Any · 0 · 1 · 2–5 · 6+)
proposals.why: Parity is a fixed set of 5 or fewer short tokens that narrows a list; it is not an outcome being recorded. M3 and Apple call that a segmented control, not a list. It is not a ChoiceList variant: ChoiceList draws vertical rows, and the record-sheet Choice caps at 4 outcomes. On one screen it does not earn a new Choice chips component. Today the options are 66x44, below the floor; inspection.filters uses PickerFields for the same kind of facet.
